ambient_events: The floor-number display ticks over and resettles.
Somewhere in the shaft, a cable sings a single low note.
The doors twitch, reconsider, and stay shut.
description: The elevator car: a mirrored box of brushed steel and warm downlight, floor smelling faintly of citrus polish. A brass rail runs waist-high around three walls, and a column of numbered buttons glows beside the door, waiting for a floor. A small screen overhead reads HALCYON TOWERS and, below it, the current car position. Step out to return to the Grand Lobby.
name: Elevator
